server.title: Server
server.subtitle_mobile: Choose TCP or Orbit, fill in the connection endpoint and token from your desktop setup, then run a connection test.

server.use_orbit_access_subtitle: Enable OAuth client credentials for Orbit Access.
server.remote_backend_token_help: Use the same token configured on your desktop Orbit daemon setup.
server.connection_test_help_tcp: Make sure your desktop app daemon is running and reachable on Tailscale, then retry this test.
server.connection_test_help_orbit: Make sure the Orbit endpoint and token match your desktop setup, then retry.
server.use_tcp_help_mobile: Use the Tailscale host from your desktop CodexMonitor app (Server section), for example `macbook.your-tailnet.ts.net:4732`.
server.use_orbit_help_mobile: Use the Orbit websocket URL and token configured on your desktop CodexMonitor setup.
server.host_token_help_desktop: This host/token is used by mobile clients and desktop remote-mode testing.
server.mobile_infra_help_tcp: Use your own infrastructure only. On iOS, get the Tailscale hostname and token from your desktop CodexMonitor setup.
server.mobile_infra_help_orbit: Use your own infrastructure only. On iOS, use the Orbit websocket URL and token configured on your desktop CodexMonitor setup.
server.desktop_infra_help: Mobile access should stay scoped to your own infrastructure (tailnet or self-hosted Orbit). CodexMonitor does not provide hosted backend services.
